name: Sparse Volume Textures
aliases: Sparse Volume Texture (SVT) Sampling in Materials
definition: Chunking large volumetric datasets into volume textures smaller than one gigavoxel to fit engine limits, then rendering them as a Heterogeneous Volume.
summary: Sparse Volume Textures is a volume rendering technique that efficiently samples large, sparse volumetric datasets stored in sparse tiles, circumventing memory limits while supporting full lighting and emission.
